- Unlock cadence: monthly micro-unlocks supported. We'll implement 12 equal monthly draws keyed to the Contract ID HB-4527 and PO 99231-BB (please reference on your side).
- VAT evidence: we will upload country ZIP (GB/FR/ES) to the Drive link by EOD.
